response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack development experience and a passion for open-source projects, but his recent work lacks deep C++ focus, industrial automation exposure, or secure development lifecycle (SDL) practices. His background in low-latency systems and multi-language proficiency is valuable, though alignment with core role requirements (C++, IEC 62443, cloud platforms) is partial.
strengths: Extensive experience with low-latency and event-driven systems (e.g., DLang at Sociomantic, Node.js at GISCollective).
Proven leadership in mentoring, technical documentation, and open-source contributions (e.g., GISCollective, Fluent-Asserts).
Diverse technical stack exposure (TypeScript, Java, C++, DLang) with adaptability to new languages/tools.
concerns: Limited recent C++ development (last notable C++ role was 2014–2015 at National Instruments).
No explicit experience with industrial cybersecurity standards (IEC 62443) or secure development lifecycle (SDL).
Primary focus on web/mobile stacks (TypeScript, React, Node.js) rather than embedded/cloud automation solutions.
